description: Review finding CON-5: Broadcast key rotation requires a second countersigned announcement for the same epoch, which §5.2.2 forbids (lens CON). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:136 vs :204. Fix: Make the uniqueness rule "at most one announcement per chain and (`epoch`, `channelToken`)". Alternatively, add `keyEpoch` to the announcement and key the rule on (`epoch`, `keyEpoch`). Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
close_reason: MOOT per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Countersigned access-key announcements removed by door-key decision B; broadcast content key and admission key rotate together sharing keyEpoch (spec/03-spaces.md §3.4 BroadcastKey; spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.2 Rotation)
